invariants.rationale: The method always returns a newly created merged Element; even if one argument is null, it returns the other, which by precondition is not null.

invariants.expression: (parentProps == null && templateProps != null && result == templateProps) || (templateProps == null && parentProps != null && result == parentProps) || (parentProps != null && templateProps != null && result != parentProps && result != templateProps)
invariants.rationale: Covers all paths: if either input is null, the other (non-null) is returned; if both are non-null, a new merged Element is returned.
The merged Element is always created with name 'properties', which is also preserved if a non-null input is returned.
At least one of the arguments must be non-null for a non-null result (otherwise unreachable code).
A valid Element (merged or input) always has a non-negative child count.
